llm_response.reason: The website exhibits several scam indicators: inaccessible privacy policy (ambiguity in customer information protection), SSL certificate issues (questionable data security), the use of non-verifiable business and contact info, and the presentation of well-known brand products (NIKKIE) without evidence of legitimate authorization. These match scam criteria #3 (psychological tactics), #4 (non-existent companies), #7 (ambiguous privacy notation), and #16 (mimicking legitimate brands).
